lines.goal_home_2: He's put it in the back of the net! Get in!
lines.goal_home_3: What a strike! The Saints are on the scoresheet!
lines.goal_home_4: Goal! St Mary's is absolutely bouncing!
lines.goal_home_6: GOAL! Nobody, and I mean nobody, saw that coming.
lines.goal_away_2: Goal to the visitors. The chairman looks like he's about to be sick.
lines.goal_away_3: And they score. Silence at St Mary's.
lines.goal_away_4: That's a goal for the opposition. Dreadful, dreadful defending.
lines.goal_away_5: They've scored, and the away end goes absolutely mental.
lines.own_goal_1: Oh dear. Oh dear oh dear. That's gone in off his own man.
lines.own_goal_2: An own goal! You simply cannot coach that.
lines.red_2: And that is a red card. Early bath, son.
lines.red_3: Off he goes! The referee had no choice whatsoever.
lines.yellow_2: Yellow card. He'll have to be careful now.
lines.foul_2: Free kick. That was a proper hack.
lines.injury_1: He's down, and he's not getting up. Here comes the stretcher.
lines.injury_2: That looks bad. Really bad. Look away now if you're squeamish.
lines.invader_1: Hold on... there's someone on the pitch!
lines.invader_2: We've got a pitch invader! And he's not wearing very much.
lines.kickoff_1: And we're under way here at St Mary's.
lines.kickoff_2: The referee blows, and off we go.
lines.halftime_1: There's the whistle for half time.
lines.halftime_2: Half time. Plenty for the chairman to think about.
lines.fulltime_win_1: Full time! Southampton have done it!
lines.fulltime_win_2: And that's the final whistle. A famous win for the Saints!
lines.fulltime_loss_1: Full time. A miserable afternoon for Southampton.
lines.fulltime_loss_2: That's it. Beaten. The chairman has already left his seat.
lines.fulltime_draw_2: The final whistle goes. A point apiece. Nobody looks happy.
lines.chance_1: Oh, he has to score there!
lines.save_1: What a save! Unbelievable stuff from the keeper!
